title: Quietly Braised Egyptian Sirloin Steak Kebabs
description: A cultured and chewy Egyptian dish featuring sirloin steak, perfect for a lazy Sunday, with a unique tempering chocolate twist and dash friendly seasoning.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, onion, garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sirloin steak cubes to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Thread the marinated steak cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes.
While the steak is baking, melt the tempering chocolate in a double boiler or in the microwave in 10 second increments, stirring between each interval.
After 20 minutes, brush the melted chocolate over the steak kebabs and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the kebabs from the oven and let them rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the quietly braised Egyptian sirloin steak kebabs hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
